name: Porte no Majokko Lesson
original_name: ポルテの魔女っ子レッスン
source:
Main character is mistakenly taken to the magical world after being confused for a twin sister by witch Porte. There is also another apprentice there. Due to magic outburst protagonist manages to return to the real world, but the two witches happen to come together with him!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女巫波尔特把主角错认成一对双胞胎姐妹中的一人，误将他带到魔法世界，那里还有另一名见习魔女。一次魔力暴走令主角成功返回现实世界，两个魔女却也跟着他一起来了！

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
